rules.text: Returns of eligible items are accepted within 30 days of delivery.
rules.quote: If you're not completely satisfied, we're happy to accept returns of eligible items within **30 days of delivery**.

rules.text: Certain product launches and exclusives must be returned or exchanged within 15 days.
rules.quote: Certain product launches and puma.com exclusives have a shorter window for returns and exchanges. This includes but is not limited to PUMA x LAMELO BALL and FENTY x PUMA Shoes which must be returned / exchanged within 15 days.

rules.text: Final sale products cannot be returned or exchanged.
rules.quote: Products that are classified as final sale cannot be returned or exchanged.

rules.text: Customized products cannot be returned except for manufacturing or material defects.
rules.quote: Custom products are nonrefundable, except in the case of manufacturing or material defects in which case you may contact Customer Service via phone or email for assistance.

rules.text: To return items purchased online to a PUMA store, bring the original form of payment and a physical or digital copy of the Order Confirmation Email.
rules.quote: Please bring the original form of payment and a physical or digital copy of the Order Confirmation Email with you so you may be refunded.

rules.text: Refunds to debit/credit cards and PayPal are credited back to the original form of payment; refunds for PUMA Gift Cards are issued as a separate E-Gift Card.
rules.quote: Purchases made by debit or credit card (including pre-paid gift cards) and through PayPal will be credited back to the original form of payment. If you paid with a PUMA Gift Card, you will be issued a separate E-Gift Card for the refunded amount.

rules.text: Returns initiated online can take 1-2 weeks to process after the return is received.
rules.quote: Returns that have been initiated on us.puma.com can take 1-2 weeks to process depending on when the return is received.

rules.text: Direct exchanges are not offered; customers must return items and place a new order.
rules.quote: We do not offer direct exchanges at this time. If you wish to exchange an item, you must go through our return process and place a new order.
